binary_majority.shares_from: every patient of T; a subset report keeps these shares

definitions.stats_file: BED's own train statistics, the stats file its code loads; the main B-BED run
definitions.counted: the same statistics counted from the train split, every value of a multi-choice evidence counted
definitions.answers: BED's own simulator (`bed.record_findings`), not the protocol's oracle: a categorical or multi-choice question is answered positive whenever the evidence is on the true disease's list, its default value included, so the answer reveals list membership; comparisons with the main policies include this
definitions.answer_differences: the categorical and multi-choice questions the main run asked up to its stop, over every patient: valued_questions of them; oracle_negative of these the protocol's oracle answers negative (the evidence is not recorded, or recorded with its default value); oracle_negative_bed_positive of those BED's simulator answers positive, both_negative the rest; oracle_negative_bed_filled of the oracle_negative_bed_positive answers are for an evidence the record lacks, which BED fills in because the true disease knows it, and the others for a recorded default value; patients_with_difference patients got at least one answer of the oracle_negative_bed_positive kind
definitions.reported: the main run minus BED's figures on the official test split (CASANDE Table 1; GTPA@1 as the official code computes it), recorded without a judgment
definitions.ladder: the main run against the policy LADDER pairs it with, on the same patients

B-BED - P2-value.factor: BED's utility, stop, smoothing and simulator (design E)
